title: Evaluating and Improving Static Application Security Testing Tools for Rust
title_zh: 评估与改进 Rust 静态应用安全测试工具

paragraphs.en: 本文评估了主流的 Rust 静态应用安全测试工具，并提出了一个名为 TRUST 的新框架以进一步改进这些工具。 Rust has become a popular systems programming language in recent years because of its strong guarantees on memory and concurrency safety. Many types of system software have been re-implemented in Rust. However, Rust programs can still suffer from common memory and concurrency vulnerabilities due to unsafe code and misunderstandings of its complex mechanisms. To mitigate such vulnerabilities, developers often rely on static application security testing (SAST) tools. However, the effectiveness of existing Rust SAST tools on real-world vulnerabilities remains underexplored. In this paper, we first conduct an empirical evaluation of mainstream Rust SAST tools using security vulnerabilities identified in real-world Rust applications. We systematically assess their effectiveness, uncover common weaknesses, and analyze the root causes behind them. Motivated by the study, we propose TRUST, a large language model (LLM)-assisted automated testing framework. TRUST automatically analyzes the official Rust reference to derive and implement semantics-preserving transformations. It leverages these transformations to generate mutant programs for evaluating Rust SAST tools and uncovering potential faults within them. Overall, TRUST has revealed 46 faults across six popular SAST tools, 17 of which have been confirmed. In addition, our study yields ten empirical findings and four practical lessons that provide actionable guidance for developing more effective, robust, and maintainable Rust SAST tools.
paragraphs.zh: 本文评估了主流的 Rust 静态应用安全测试工具，并提出了一个名为 TRUST 的新框架以进一步改进这些工具。近年来，Rust 因其在内存安全和并发安全方面的强大保障，已成为一种流行的系统编程语言。 许多种类的系统软件已经用 Rust 重新实现。 然而，由于不安全代码（unsafe code）以及对其复杂机制的误解，Rust 程序仍然可能遭受常见的内存漏洞和并发漏洞。 为了缓解此类漏洞，开发者通常依赖静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具。 然而，现有 Rust SAST 工具在真实世界漏洞上的有效性仍未得到充分探索。 在本文中，我们首先使用在真实世界 Rust 应用中发现的安全漏洞，对主流 Rust SAST 工具进行了实证评估。 我们系统地评估了它们的有效性，揭示了共同的弱点，并分析了其背后的根本原因。 受该研究的启发，我们提出了 TRUST，一个大语言模型（LLM）辅助的自动化测试框架。 TRUST 自动分析 Rust 官方参考文档，以推导并实现保持语义的变换。 它利用这些变换生成变异程序，用于评估 Rust SAST 工具并发现其中潜在的缺陷。 总体而言，TRUST 在六个流行的 SAST 工具中揭示了 46 个缺陷，其中 17 个已被确认。 此外，我们的研究得出了十项实证发现和四条实践经验，为开发更有效、更健壮、更易维护的 Rust SAST 工具提供了可操作的指导。
